## 🚦 Type of Change

## 🧪 Quality and Verification Checklist

Please verify that all verification benchmarks succeed before submitting:

- [ ] **Type Check**: My local typescript environment generates zero compile warnings (`npx tsc --noEmit`).
- [ ] **Linter Check**: Running modern syntax validations returns zero warnings or lint errors (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] **Production Build**: Verified locally that compiling optimized bundles works successfully (`npm run build`).
- [ ] **Behavioral Consistency**: Switched language and theme controls to confirm that RTL, scale orientations, and audio layers remain functional.
